specifications_json: {"lens_mount":"Micro Four Thirds","What lenses are compatible with MISSION 1 PRO ILS?":"MISSION 1 PRO ILS uses a native Micro Four Thirds (MFT) mount and requires lenses with manual focus and manual (or fixed) aperture control, since the camera body has no electronic contacts. See our support page for a list of compatible lenses.","What is the crop factor / full-frame 35mm equivalent?":"The MISSION 1 PRO ILS sensor has a crop factor of approximately 2.7x (without image stabilization) or 3x (with image stabilization applied) compared to full-frame 35mm. For example, a 17mm MFT lens is roughly equivalent to a 50mm lens on a full-frame camera.","Is image stabilization supported?":"Yes, MISSION 1 PRO ILS supports HyperSmooth stabilization for prime rectilinear lenses with a focal length between 6mm–500mm.
